The more of you that I ins-
pect

lips

rips But when I seek out
your voice

noise

test ease
Raving impossibili-
ties

starts to smoke

twist

nist

change

ranged

[D#5]ring of the sinew My

[G5]ty's got my bones It pulls
[G#5]my flesh away The
[A5]steam find dissipates I make out

[D#5]
[F5]

choose

me

be

maze
